_comment: Update currentSeasonPlaylistUrl once a year, right after the new season's YouTube playlist goes up on the channel. Leave it empty ("") when there is no current-season playlist yet (e.g. during preseason) -- the sync script no-ops safely in that case instead of pulling from the wrong season.
_specialsComment: One-off tournament playlists (e.g. a World Cup) that sync into content/specials/<id>.json instead of a gameweek file. Episodes on these playlists are identified by an episode number prefix in the title ("326 - ..."), not a GW number. Remove an entry once the tournament special is retired.
